[Section] Baselines
[source_id=54] Task: given a caption and a paired image (if used), the goal is to label every token in a caption in BIO scheme (B: beginning, I: inside, O: outside) BIBREF27 . We report the performance of the following state-of-the-art NER models as baselines, as well as several configurations of our proposed approach to examine contributions of each component (W: word, C: char, V: visual).
[source_id=55] Bi-LSTM/CRF (W only): only takes word token embeddings (Stanford GloVE) as input. The rest of the architecture is kept the same.
[source_id=56] Bi-LSTM/CRF + Bi-CharLSTM (C only): only takes a character sequence of each word token as input. (No word embeddings)
[source_id=57] Bi-LSTM/CRF + Bi-CharLSTM (W+C) BIBREF0 : takes as input both word embeddings and character embeddings extracted from a Bi-CharLSTM. Entity LSTM takes concatenated vectors of word and character embeddings as input tokens.
[source_id=58] Bi-LSTM/CRF + CharCNN (W+C) BIBREF1 : uses character embeddings extracted from a CNN instead.
[source_id=59] Bi-LSTM/CRF + CharCNN (W+C) + Multi-task BIBREF8 : trains the model to perform both recognition (into multiple entity types) as well as segmentation (binary) tasks.
[source_id=60] (proposed) Bi-LSTM/CRF + Bi-CharLSTM with modality attention (W+C): uses the modality attention to merge word and character embeddings.
[source_id=61] (proposed) Bi-LSTM/CRF + Bi-CharLSTM + Inception (W+C+V): takes as input visual contexts extracted from InceptionNet as well, concatenated with word and char vectors.
[source_id=62] (proposed) Bi-LSTM/CRF + Bi-CharLSTM + Inception with modality attention (W+C+V): uses the modality attention to merge word, character, and visual embeddings as input to entity LSTM.
